public_rationale: METR found a 19% slowdown for experienced developers working in familiar repositories, supporting that part of the claim. Google's randomized trial found a speedup on a complex enterprise task, contradicting the claim that coding LLMs do not speed engineers up. The evidence supports different effects in different settings, not a general slowdown.
limitations: The trials should not be pooled into an industry-wide estimate without accounting for their different settings.
Google evaluated its own internal tools.
Neither study establishes the effect of later tools.
